title: (Senior) Accountant
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

  • We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to support the accounting, financial reporting, and regulatory reporting activities of Bybit’s European entities.
  • This role will be responsible for managing core accounting processes, month-end and year-end closing activities, financial reporting, and supporting audits within a rapidly growing and highly regulated fintech environment.
  • You will work closely with Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Product teams, external auditors, and outsourced accounting providers to ensure accurate financial reporting and robust financial controls.
  • Beyond traditional accounting responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to help design and build scalable accounting processes, reporting frameworks, and finance controls for one of Europe’s fastest-growing regulated digital asset businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements under Austrian GAAP (UGB)
  • Oversee general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and month-end close processes
  • Support the preparation of regulatory and financial reporting for Austrian and European entities
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, outsourced accounting providers, and regulatory stakeholders
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with Austrian accounting and regulatory requirements
  • Assist in implementing and improving accounting controls, finance processes, and ERP workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Treasury, Compliance, Legal, Product, Operations, and Tax teams on finance-related matters
  • Support accounting analysis relating to crypto assets, safeguarding balances, payment flows, and fintech products
  • Assist with the implementation of new accounting policies, reporting requirements, and regulatory developments
  • Drive automation, process improvement, and finance transformation initiatives
  • Support strategic projects, licensing initiatives, and expansion activities from an accounting and reporting perspective
  • Maintain robust documentation, controls, and audit trails across key finance processes

Requirements

  • 6+ years of accounting, audit, or financial reporting experience, ideally within fintech, crypto, banking, financial services, payments, or another international environment
  • Strong knowledge of Austrian GAAP (UGB) and financial reporting principles
  • Experience working with audits, financial statements, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting requirements
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable collaborating across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, and operational teams
  • Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite is considered a plus
  • Austrian accounting qualifications (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter) and/or experience gained within a Big 4 audit practice, financial institution, or multinational finance function are considered a strong advantage
  • Professional fluency in English is required; German is considered a strong advantage

Nice to Have

  • Experience within financial services, fintech, payments, crypto, or other regulated industries
  • Exposure to regulatory reporting and regulated financial institutions
  • Knowledge of crypto asset accounting and safeguarding concepts
  • Experience supporting finance transformation, process automation, or ERP implementation projects
  • Experience working with regulatory stakeholders, auditors, and supervisory requirements

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
